Yasuo|mid.identity: Crit-based physical damage fighter. His passive doubles his crit chance and gives him a Flow shield as he moves. Steel Tempest (Q) strikes in a line and, on the third cast, launches a tornado that knocks up; Wind Wall (W) blocks projectiles; Sweeping Blade (E) dashes through a target (Q during the dash strikes in a circle); Last Breath (R) teleports onto a knocked-up target. Very often played and very often banned.
Yasuo|mid.playstyle: Mid fighter who punishes projectile mages with Wind Wall and chains knock-ups with his team in teamfights. He's strong against immobile or projectile-based mages (Akshan, Ryze, Orianna), but struggles against zone-control mages (Lissandra, Taliyah, Annie) and against Vladimir.
Yasuo|mid.early_game: Stack Q on minions to keep your tornado ready, trade when your Flow shield is full. Use E from minion to minion to stick to your opponent or escape. Keep W for the enemy's key ability (a projectile).
Yasuo|mid.level_2: Sweeping Blade (E). E through a minion toward your opponent → Q: a short trade.
Yasuo|mid.level_3: Wind Wall (W). Save it for the enemy's most dangerous projectile (stun, burst).
Yasuo|mid.level_6: Last Breath: on a target knocked up by your tornado or by an ally. Combo: E → Q3 (tornado) → R. Roam bot if your jungler or support has knock-ups.
power_spikes: First completed item: heavy crit damage.
Two items: teamfights with your team's knock-ups.
Yasuo|mid.lane_plan: Stack Q, trade when your shield is full and keep W for the key ability. Push and roam when your ultimate can take advantage of allied knock-ups. The mid role quest (faster recall) makes your roams more profitable.
Yasuo|mid.trading: Short trade: E through your opponent → Q → back off with E on a minion. All-in: Q3 tornado → R → attacks. Give up on it against zone-control mages (Lissandra, Taliyah) when their abilities are ready.
threats: Vladimir, who heals and dodges with his Sanguine Pool.
Aurelion Sol, who keeps you at range.
mistakes: Using W on an unimportant ability.
Engaging without your Flow shield or tornado.
Dashing into an enemy wave with no way out.

matchup_notes.Yone: A mobility duel: wait for his E, and keep the tornado for when he snaps back.
matchup_notes.Ahri: Wind Wall blocks her Charm: save it for that ability.
matchup_notes.Lissandra: Her CC and ultimate stop you: don't engage while she has W.
matchup_notes.Vladimir: He dodges your ultimate with his Sanguine Pool: wait until he's used it.

Yasuo|mid.mid_game: Roams with your team's knock-ups and skirmishes around objectives.
Yasuo|mid.late_game: Go in after your team's knock-ups, ultimate on several targets, Wind Wall to protect your carries.
Yasuo|mid.ahead: Roam, take objectives and force fights.
Yasuo|mid.behind: Farm and play with your team: your ultimate depends on allied knock-ups.
Yasuo|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to block key abilities with Wind Wall and chain knock-ups with your ultimate in teamfights.
Yasuo|mid.final_tip: Save your Wind Wall for the enemy's most important ability.
